notes.title: Ultimate Battle 1.1: CHRISTMAS UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1]💡💡 Version 1.1 "Christmas Update"💡💡[/h1]

[b]✅ New dedicated Christmas-themed map [Temporary Exclusive][/b].
[b]✅ New Christmas-themed weapon [Temporary Exclusive][/b].
[b]✅ New Christmas-themed menu background[/b]
[b]✅ New logo[/b].
[b]✅ Character name change[/b].

Please note that the Christmas-themed update will start tomorrow 12/20/2020 and will end on 01/06/2021.

Stay tuned by following the [url=https://twitter.com/UltimateBattle6]Twitter[/url] page as well.

notes.title: Working on the Christmas Update
notes.content:
[b]I am working on the very first update that will be released before Christmas.[/b]

A Christmas-themed map and a dedicated weapon will be added.
And other interesting things will be added.

[h3]Stay tuned[/h3]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/9w475hDWEPVlu/source.gif[/img]
